theme: Small talk đầu giờ & pantry chat

vocab.example: I overslept and missed the morning standup by five minutes.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi bị ngủ quên và lỡ buổi standup buổi sáng mất năm phút.

vocab.example: We had a quick chit-chat in the pantry before work started.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi tán gẫu nhanh ở pantry trước khi bắt đầu làm việc.

vocab.example: The office is quiet before rush hour traffic builds up outside.
vocab.example_vi: Văn phòng khá yên tĩnh trước khi giờ cao điểm bắt đầu đông đúc bên ngoài.

vocab.example: He heated his lunch in the microwave next to the fridge.
vocab.example_vi: Anh ấy hâm nóng bữa trưa trong lò vi sóng cạnh tủ lạnh.

vocab.example: She keeps instant noodles in her desk for busy days.
vocab.example_vi: Cô ấy để sẵn mì ăn liền trong ngăn bàn cho những ngày bận rộn.

vocab.example: There was a queue for coffee right before the standup meeting.
vocab.example_vi: Có một hàng người xếp hàng lấy cà phê ngay trước buổi standup.

vocab.example: Please wipe up if you spill coffee on the shared desk.
vocab.example_vi: Làm ơn lau sạch nếu bạn làm đổ cà phê lên bàn dùng chung.

vocab.example: A short walk helps me recharge before the afternoon sprint planning.
vocab.example_vi: Một đoạn đi bộ ngắn giúp tôi nạp lại năng lượng trước buổi lập kế hoạch sprint chiều.

lines.speaker: Nam (Developer)
lines.text: Morning, Linh! You look tired today.

lines.speaker: Linh (Tester)
lines.text: Yeah, I overslept and missed the bus. Rush hour was brutal.

lines.speaker: Nam (Developer)
lines.text: Same here. The traffic near the office was crazy this morning.

lines.speaker: Linh (Tester)
lines.text: Let's grab some coffee before the standup. I really need it.

lines.speaker: Nam (Developer)
lines.text: Good idea. Did you try the new instant noodles in the pantry?

lines.speaker: Linh (Tester)
lines.text: Not yet, I'm still in line — there's a queue for the microwave.

lines.speaker: Nam (Developer)
lines.text: Careful, someone spilled coffee on the counter earlier.

lines.speaker: Linh (Tester)
lines.text: Thanks for the heads-up. I just need ten minutes to recharge before the meeting.

lines.speaker: Nam (Developer)
lines.text: No worries, we still have five minutes before the standup starts.

lines.speaker: Linh (Tester)
lines.text: Perfect, let's just chit-chat until then.

options: She overslept and missed the bus
She worked all night on a bug

questions.q: What does Linh want to do before the standup?
What warning does Nam give Linh?
options: Someone spilled coffee on the counter

shadowing: I overslept this morning, so I missed my usual bus to work.
The rush hour traffic near our office was really bad again today.
Can we grab a coffee before the standup meeting starts?
There's a long queue for the microwave in the pantry right now.
Someone spilled coffee on the counter, so please be careful.
